verify.note: Fails on unpatched main at the first arm (staff-calendar.tsx titles the drawer Edit entry) and passes with the patch. Every arm names its site and the canon it answers to. Three doc arms were INVERTED by LIVE-475 because they had frozen a false sentence in place: the doc said a day with several items is drawn as one stacked block (LIVE-467's bug, written one PR after the fix) and the arm banned the true wording; the doc said Guest and Admin are two EventCalendar mounts with separate months and the arm banned "The same sliding month as Guest", which is what PROG-CAL12 made true; and the doc said the switchers are hand-rolled "until HYG-105 lands", which shipped in #2869. The three arms now ban the FALSE sentences, a fourth bans the stale HYG-105 promise, a fifth bans the claim that a pasted console link restores the month (adminViewHref writes view, item, plan and console only), and the "four views from one segmented control" arm keeps its ban and loses its out-of-date reason. Mutation-tested 2026-09-22 (thirteen single-arm reverts) and 2026-09-23 (each of the five doc arms re-fired by restoring the sentence it now bans).
